purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-FX-AUTHORING at FX-7 without inventing clock or journal envelopes. v2 restores the full v9 intent so the 'single differing decision' honesty sentence is not dropped. Journals remain unauthored.

pttV9.fx7Intent: Run the whole of FX-4 and FX-5 with the host clock stepped backwards, stepped forwards, frozen, and with control-plane messages delayed and reordered within what the transport allows. Assert the resulting journals are byte-identical to the unperturbed run modulo the timestamp DATA fields, and that no decision differed. A single differing decision means a clock or an arrival order entered the ordering.
